text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The next scrimmage is a 1,800-meter turf
run. The track is still a bit
damp from last
night's rain, so we might see some
unexpected results!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. Two, two, three,
hey! Three, two, three, four.
Four, two,
three, hey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser is taking part in a scrimmage
race today. Among her
opponents are the
formidable Mihono Bourbon and Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't made much of a name for
herself yet, so there aren't many
cheers for
her.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so Machitan's running today, I see! I
heard that she did really
great in that
special training session the other day.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and not only that, she even
managed to keep up with Bourbon
and
Rice in group sessions!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It would appear that word's getting out
about our ambitious little
friend.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitan! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stirred by Twin Turbo's hearty words of
encouragement, cheers begin
to ring out
from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wowie, now there's some pressure! All
right, head in the game, me.
I'm gonna win
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Head held high after the boost from the
crowd, Matikanetannhauser
heads for the
starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon with a five-... six-...
seven-length lead! The fight for
second
place is heating up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon prevails with a wide lead
in the homestretch, and

Matikanetannhauser is unable to overtake
Rice Shower for second
place.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is way out front! It's a
landslide victory!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
I kind of thought that Machitan would,
well... stand out a little bit
more than
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the thunderous applause for
Mihono Bourbon, barely a word
escapes
the mouths of those who had been
cheering for my partner.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sorry, Trainer. It looks like I still got a long ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the mushy turf ended up
hurting me a bit. I'll need to build
even
more leg muscle... somehow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how disappointed
Tannhauser must be, I resolve to
get back
to the drawing board to build a new
regimen. But then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling positively peckish right about
now. Think I'll head to the
cafeteria! Ehe,
wonder what I should get. Udon's sounding
pretty
yummy, I think.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We begin to eat lunch without one word
about the morning's race. I
wonder if my
concern is somewhat misplaced.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? You're kinda starin' off
into space.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Feeling down? Because of what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's completely moved on. I
choose my next words carefully
so as not
to cause any undue stress.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's it! It's true that I was pretty
disappointed right after the
race, but that
means I just have to keep practicing and
improving.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... yeah. No time to dwell on that when I
could be dwelling on this
bowl of noodles
instead. And on how to adjust my training
plan, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, these carrot bits are dee-lish!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I get that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone! Whaddya get?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pretty sure I get exactly what your trainer
here's thinking. You were
probably
wondering how she can act all normal after
something like
that, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser's always the calmest of the
bunch out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Surely you've never seen her cry or fuss
when things don't go her way
during
training, yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's certainly true, now that I think
about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I'm okay, I'm okay! My legs are just a
little shaky. Looks like I've
still got work to
do.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Really? 'Cause you were pretty awesome
up till those last three
hundred meters.
You were right on her tail!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff... Ha... I don't... think sooo!

text_block_list.name: Robber A
text_block_list.text:
It's been almost twenty minutes straight of
this. How is she not totally
exhausted by
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always acted really... normal.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: People don't seem to pick up on that about her. I doubt she's even thought that hard about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait... wait... Did you just compliment me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's simply how she is, so please
continue to look after our dear
friend.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oho, come on now. What are you two? My
parents?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They might not be her parents, but they
have shown me a little more
of
Matikanetannhauser's hidden greatness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tenacity seldom wavers, and that's a
sort of strength few can
achieve.
